title: Non-invasive localization of the ventricular excitation origin without patient-specific geometries using deep learning
summary: Two CNNs trained on more than one million simulated body-surface-potential maps were evaluated on clinical ECG/BSPM data to localize ventricular excitation origin. The arXiv v1 reported median localization error of 32 mm and up to 82% transmural-position detection; this is a proof of principle, not clinical deployment or outcome benefit.

evidence.tested: Preprint Results: clinical localization median error 32 mm, up to 82% transmural-position detection; ranked top-3 results improved localization. This is a proof of principle, with substantial residual error.
evidence.unknown: Methods/Results use simulated test data plus a separate clinical dataset; the article reports clinical test error and classification performance but no clinical deployment or patient outcomes. Narrow technical clinical-reference validation only.
